criteria.requirement: Add actual compare_to rule with schema-validated {field, operator, missing} using only lt/le/eq/ne/ge/gt. Resolve existing sibling/dotted/root ^ paths through the real lookup protocol after normalization, distinguish missing targets from existing None, default missing to error or explicitly ignore, and report failed/incomparable comparisons in native field error trees. Reject unknown operators at schema validation, never eval strings or alter dependencies/min/max semantics.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
